newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Libya's Gaddafi defends Jordanian soldier.
newsitem.headline: Libya's Gaddafi defends Jordanian soldier.

text.p: Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi defended the Jordanian soldier who killed seven Israeli schoolgirls last week, saying he was driven to insanity by Israel's occupation of Arab land.

"We are against striking civilians and striking children. We are fundamentally against that...(but) the Jordanian soldier who fired at Israelis is not mad, he was made crazy by the occupation," the official Libyan news agency JANA on Sunday quoted Gaddafi as saying on Saturday night.
"He is not mad, they (the Israelis) made him mad," Gaddafi added. JANA, monitored in Tunis, said the Libyan leader was addressing a rally in the southern city of Sebha.

Jordanian army driver Sergeant Ahmed Moussa Mustafa al-Dagamsa emptied the clip of his rifle on Thursday at the girls on a school trip to a strip of Jordanian land south of the Sea of Galilea leased to Israel under a 1994 peace treaty.
He was arrested and the Jordanian authorities have said that there was no evidence the murder was politically-motivated.
